⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

## Episode Thesis

The episode is a macro segment on US data with SEB US expert Elisabeth Koppelman. PCE inflation came in below expectations after methodology changes, while GDP was revised up and consumption stayed strong. She thinks the Fed can hold rates in October, sees rising long yields as mostly a normalisation driven by policy-rate expectations, and warns that central banks may overtighten and later have to cut. Upcoming NFP data and US fiscal debt are flagged as key risks, as is the AI-hyperscaler capex cycle, whose reversal could hit the economy hard. No individual stocks were discussed as investments.
